scope: Shared named audio connections; legacy configurations and Pebble/direct callers retained

requirements.contract: Startup audio.providers lookup by name/type plus shared session runtime overrides; no process-global mutable selection or settings.json rewrite.
TTS/read/narration/choices/cascade and STT/PTT dispatch through the selected named connection; admitted requests retain their resolved settings.
Unconfigured builtins preserve legacy provider blocks, environment, aliases and saved overrides. Partial shared edits retain legacy endpoint/auth. No active capture/routing change.
OpenAI uses keys; Azure supports Entra az-token and keys. Key references never resolve to another account when missing. Secrets are not accepted by /audio, shown in status, or persisted.
MAI STT accepts a shared Azure resource endpoint or /stt-/tts-qualified resource URL, preserves non-Azure proxy prefixes and uses raw bearer auth. Pebble explicit library options remain independent.
Real Pi settings select/input/cancel, reload restore, same process, unchanged startup provider config and clean terminal exit; late dialogs cannot use retired ctx or mutate state.

budgets.runtime_flush: synchronous per successful user edit; no idle timer

activation: Source changes only; no live agents reloaded, settings migrated, microphone opened or audio played. No unsupported AHP capability advertised.
